name: ebda-sites
description: Hidden preview multi-page sites for Ebda AI Studio sub-brands (events, marketing, design).

scripts.typecheck: node --check scripts/build.mjs && node --check lib/render.mjs && node --check lib/geometry.mjs && node --check lib/contact.js && node --check lib/worker.mjs
scripts.deploy: node scripts/build.mjs && for s in events marketing design; do (cd sites/$s && wrangler deploy) || exit 1; done
